capabilities: edit Base table cells inline, including text, dates, checkboxes, lists and wiki links
reorder rows manually with drag handles using note-property or Base-view ranks
move notes between groups by dragging to update their properties
configure views with nested horizontal and vertical groups, colors and column layouts
display per-property summaries per group and in a total row
extras: Not yet approved for the Community plugins directory, so manual installation from GitHub releases is required. The README warns to back up the vault before trying a plugin that writes properties, notes that formula/computed properties are read-only, and says mobile touch dragging has not been validated.
intentEvidence: Editable tables and board columns for Obsidian Bases, with manual row ordering.
problem: Obsidian's Bases views are read-only grids, so you cannot edit properties in place, drag rows into a manual order, or move notes between groups directly from the view.
summary: Editable Bases view that lets you edit table cells in place, reorder rows by drag, and organize notes with nested groups, board columns, colors, and summaries.
